summary_en: This early phase 1 trial tests whether the study drug ulixertinib can cross the blood-brain barrier in people with recurrent MAPK-activated gliomas. Ulixertinib is taken by mouth twice a day; in the surgical group it is taken for two weeks before tumor removal on about day 14, and in the non-surgical group it is taken continuously in 28-day cycles. The main outcome measure is not stated in the record, and the study is listed as early phase 1.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase temprana 1 evalúa si el medicamento en estudio, ulixertinib, puede atravesar la barrera hematoencefálica en personas con gliomas activados por MAPK recurrentes. Ulixertinib se toma por vía oral dos veces al día; en el grupo quirúrgico se toma durante dos semanas antes de extirpar el tumor, alrededor del día 14, y en el grupo no quirúrgico se toma de forma continua en ciclos de 28 días. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro, y el estudio figura como fase temprana 1.
who_for: Adults 18 or older for the surgical group; people 12 or older for the non-surgical group
Recurrent MAPK-activated glioma, mixed glioma, or glioneural tumor
Tumor with RAS/RAF/MEK/ERK pathway mutation or activation shown by a report
Progressive disease by RANO criteria, with prior radiation or chemotherapy depending on tumor grade
Karnofsky performance status of 60 or higher and adequate organ function
not_for: Bevacizumab treatment within 3 months before enrollment
Pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning pregnancy during the trial
Retinal vein occlusion or central serous retinopathy, or risk of them
